verifiedSurfaceSummary: Native browser checks on 2026-10-23 found www.waycool.in/career HTTP 404, while waycool.in/career, both host homepages and www.waycool.in/job-opportunities.php failed transport. Search-index career discovery still shows Join Us to the legacy endpoint; no current accessible employer-bound native inventory was recovered. Public LinkedIn employer discovery exposes no See jobs handoff; WayCool Labs is a separate employer. Job counts, countries, dates and role contracts remain unknown. The collector retries the www career variant and legacy endpoint, raises a typed coverage gap and disallows cleanup.
